name: Kauai
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Kauai, HI 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids on Kauai, Hawaii for 2026: Lights on Rice Parade, Waimea Light Parade and Santa's House at Kukui Grove, dates checked on host sites.
lede: Kauai celebrates Christmas with two community light parades, Lights on Rice in Lihue and the Waimea Light Parade on the west side, plus Santa's House at Kukui Grove Center.
celebrates: Kauai's Christmas season starts with Santa's House at Kukui Grove Center in Lihue on November 27. The Rotary Club of Kauai holds the Lights on Rice Parade on the first Friday of December, closing Rice Street for about 60 parade units and 3,000 performers. On the west side, the Historic Waimea Theater and Cultural Arts Center presents the Waimea Light Parade, followed by a free holiday concert at Hofgaard Park. Both parades are community events that ask entries to be family friendly.
lastyear: The Waimea Light Parade site shares a recap of its 2025 parade, which featured entries inspired by favorite cartoon characters, from Disney classics to other animated favorites, along three quarters of a mile of lights and music. The Lights on Rice Parade site shows photos from past parades and says the event is held on the first Friday in December each year. Kukui Grove Center has run a Santa's House each holiday season and moves it to a new spot in the center every year, according to the center.
facts: The Waimea Light Parade is in its 26th year, according to its organizer. The Rotary Club of Kauai limits the Lights on Rice Parade to 65 entries and charges float entry fees of $50 for nonprofits and $100 for for-profit groups, while schools and government entries pay nothing. Kukui Grove Center says Santa doesn't like to always be in the same place, so his house changes spots each season.
trains: The Kauai Plantation Railway runs narrated train tours of the 105-acre Kilohana Plantation near Lihue, according to the plantation's website. It is the island's best known train ride for kids, but we did not find a 2026 Christmas train there, so check the plantation's site for current hours and prices before you go. The Lights on Rice Parade and Santa's House are both in Lihue, close to Kilohana.
train_links: A narrated train tour of Kilohana Plantation near Lihue.
traditions: The Rotary Club of Kauai's parade on the first Friday of December, with Rice Street closed from 5:30 pm.
A lighted parade through Waimea town, now in its 26th year.
A free concert with refreshments at Hofgaard Park after the parade.
Photos with Santa and Mrs. Claus, with a new spot in the center each year.
kidfact: Kauai's Lights on Rice Parade closes an entire street so that about 3,000 performers can march past families.
faq: Kauai holds community light parades in Lihue and Waimea, and Kukui Grove Center in Lihue hosts Santa's House through the season. The Rotary Club of Kauai runs Lights on Rice on the first Friday of December, and the Waimea Light Parade follows later in the month with a free holiday concert.
Are the Kauai Christmas parades free to watch?
Yes. Both parades are public community events. Entry fees on the parade sites apply only to groups that march or build floats, and the Waimea site promotes a free concert after its parade.
Where can kids meet Santa on Kauai?
Santa's House at Kukui Grove Center in Lihue, between Famous Footwear and Premier Martial Arts. You can schedule photos online or walk in, though scheduled photos go first.
Is there a Christmas train on Kauai?
We did not find a 2026 Christmas train. The Kauai Plantation Railway runs narrated tours at Kilohana Plantation near Lihue, so check its website for current hours and prices.
What should we know before going to a parade?
Streets close early, at 5:30 pm for Lights on Rice and 5 pm in Waimea, and parking is limited, so arrive early. Waimea asks visitors to park on side roads.
sources: Historic Waimea Theater and Cultural Arts Center
intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Kauai for 2026, and here is what he found: 3 family events, 2 of them free. The magic runs from November 27 (Santa's House at Kukui Grove) through December 26, with the Lights on Rice Parade (December 4) and the Waimea Light Parade (December 19) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Kauai

  • 3 Christmas events for kids on Kauai
  • 2 free events: the Lights on Rice Parade in Lihue and the Waimea Light Parade
  • Meet Santa: Santa's House at Kukui Grove in Lihue (November 27 to December 26)
  • Parades and lights: Lights on Rice Parade (December 4) and Waimea Light Parade (December 19)
  • Trains: the Kauai Plantation Railway runs narrated train tours at Kilohana Plantation near Lihue
  • Season: November 27 to December 26
